questions.content: Heat given to a body which raises its temperature by <mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="SVG" overflow="overflow"><svg style="vertical-align: -0.05ex;" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="3.838ex" height="1.645ex" role="img" focusable="false" viewBox="0 -705 1696.6 727" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink"><g stroke="currentColor" fill="currentColor" stroke-width="0" transform="scale(1,-1)"><g data-mml-node="math"><g data-mml-node="TeXAtom" data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><g data-mml-node="msup"><g data-mml-node="mn"><use data-c="31" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-N-31"></use></g><g data-mml-node="mo" transform="translate(533,363) scale(0.707)"><use data-c="2218" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-N-2218"></use></g></g></g><g data-mml-node="mi" transform="translate(936.6,0)"><use data-c="1D436" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-I-1D436"></use></g></g></g></svg></mjx-container> is
questions.explanation: Heat required for raising the temperature of the whole body by <mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="SVG" overflow="overflow"><svg style="vertical-align: -0.05ex;" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="3.838ex" height="1.645ex" role="img" focusable="false" viewBox="0 -705 1696.6 727" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink"><g stroke="currentColor" fill="currentColor" stroke-width="0" transform="scale(1,-1)"><g data-mml-node="math"><g data-mml-node="TeXAtom" data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><g data-mml-node="msup"><g data-mml-node="mn"><use data-c="31" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-N-31"></use></g><g data-mml-node="mo" transform="translate(533,363) scale(0.707)"><use data-c="2218" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-N-2218"></use></g></g></g><g data-mml-node="mi" transform="translate(936.6,0)"><use data-c="1D436" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-I-1D436"></use></g></g></g></svg></mjx-container> is called the thermal capacity of the body.
